@graph.headline: Managed On-Premise: On-Premise Without the IT Burden
@graph.description: What managed on-premise software is and how it differs from a classic self-hosted server: installed and maintained by the vendor, remote access without open ports, offline capture — and when cloud is still the better fit.

mainEntity.name: Do I need IT staff for managed on-premise software?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The vendor installs, updates and repairs the appliance remotely. Your part is keeping it powered and connected.

mainEntity.name: Is on-premise more secure than cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not automatically. It reduces exposure when the appliance has no open ports and data never leaves the building — but the implementation matters more than the label. Ask how remote access and updates are secured.
That varies by vendor. With Elenchon, you buy the appliance at cost and it is yours, along with the data on it. See pricing and deployment.
With Elenchon there is no exit fee, and you keep view-only access to your historical records for audits. Ask any vendor for the same in writing.
